tickets.summary: Fix memory leak in WebSocket connection pool
tickets.description: WebSocket connections that disconnect abnormally are not being cleaned up from the connection pool. After 48h of operation, the service exhausts its 10k connection limit. Heap dumps show Connection objects retained by the ConnectionRegistry map.
tickets.acceptance_criteria:
* Abnormal disconnections trigger cleanup within 30s
* Connection pool size stays stable over 72h soak test
* Heap usage does not grow unbounded
* Monitoring alert fires if pool exceeds 80% capacity
tickets.test_plan: Unit: mock abnormal disconnect, verify cleanup callback. Integration: 72h soak test with chaos monkey killing connections.
tickets.reproduction_steps:
1. Deploy service to staging
2. Generate 5000 WS connections
3. Kill 50% of clients abruptly (no close frame)
4. Wait 1h, check pool size
5. Pool shows 5000 (should show ~2500)
tickets.expected_behavior: Pool size returns to ~2500 after cleanup
tickets.actual_behavior: Pool stays at 5000, leaked connections never cleaned
tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: connection cleanup logic. Out of scope: connection pool resizing, WebSocket protocol changes.

tickets.description: Cache frequent search queries in Redis with a 5-minute TTL. Cache key should include the query string, filters, sort order, and page number. Cache invalidation should happen on relevant index updates.

tickets.scope_boundaries: In scope: query caching, TTL, invalidation. Out of scope: result ranking changes, query suggestion caching.
